description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR5. Hard prerequisite: fz-kdt.98.3 must land first. This solver consumes CallGraphComponent as its group-membership authority; before fz-kdt.98.3 adds function-reference and resolved value-call edges, that authority under-approximates recursion.

DeriveCallGraphComponent (jobs/keying.rs ~167) publishes CallGraphComponent(f), consumed by nothing in the semantic fixpoint; returns are published per activation per revision to every caller through a Current read (jobs/semantic.rs ~1782). Consume the SCC fact: one job iterates the members' returns locally and publishes each member's ReturnType once; a return read whose only support is inside the reader's own cone contributes no ascent (fz-kdt.64's cyclic-copies clause, landing here). Model on pull.rs ~793/2077 stage_recursive_group. Tests: compiler2_recursive_group_publishes_one_settled_return_per_member, compiler2_recursive_group_wakes_callers_once, admission-order invariance (FIFO, LIFO, permuted: identical facts and artifacts). Signal: ReturnType-caused applied steps on json_roundtrip from 1007 toward the member count; AnalyzeActivation runs per activation single digits.

comments.text: Plan correction after merged PR #185: .177.9 consumes the merged derivation-identity scheduler foundation (fz-kdt.228), but does not need recursive @type resolution (#212 / fz-kdt.177.8). Its causal work is scheduling one return group via CallGraphComponent; μ equation closure belongs to .177.10. The .177.8 dependency was removed. Post-#185 json_roundtrip baseline is 4091 job starts and 2 drain arbitrations (from 4527 / 155), with byte-identical corpus canon. .98.3 remains the hard graph-completeness gate via .98.2.

title: A recursive group's returns are solved once; cyclic copies are never new ground
